name: Racing chronograph
summary: The watch for the stopwatch era of motor racing. It has a steel case, a dark dial with two or three sub dials, two pushers and a tachymeter scale. The Speedmaster of 1957 and the Carrera of 1963 set the type.

philosophy.core_thesis: A racing chronograph is a stopwatch on the wrist. Its dial shows elapsed time and average speed in one glance, and the case stays slim enough to fit under a cuff.
design_principles: Fit two pushers at 2 and 4 o'clock, so that the driver starts, stops and resets the timer with one hand.
Print a tachymeter scale from 60 to 500 on the bezel or on the dial rim. It gives the speed over one measured mile or kilometre.
Arrange two or three sub dials in a balanced pattern, each 8 to 10 mm wide, for the running seconds, the minutes and the hours.
Use a matt dial in black, grey or white, with high contrast against the hands and the sub dials.
Cut the case 38 to 42 mm wide and 12 to 14 mm thick, so that the watch fits under a driving glove.
Add a stepped sapphire or domed acrylic crystal that keeps the glare low.
Choose a perforated leather strap, so that the wrist stays cool in a car.
Use a red or orange seconds hand and one signal colour on the dial.
anti_patterns: A single sub dial with no timing scale
A tachymeter in tiny print that no one can read
A thick case that does not go under a cuff
A gold case with a pale enamel dial
Pushers that are too small for a glove
A dial with six colours and a busy pattern

silhouette.shape: A round steel case with two pushers, a crown, a bezel with a speed scale and two or three small circles on the dial.
silhouette.line: A circle with lugs that curve down, two straight pushers and a thin bezel that carries the scale.
silhouette.fit: The case sits flat on the wrist and goes under a cuff or a glove.
silhouette.proportion: Case thickness to width about 1 to 3; the sub dials fill about 40 per cent of the dial; the pushers are 6 mm long.
rules: Place the sub dials at 3, 6 and 9, or at 3 and 9 with a date at 6.
Make the sub dial hands thinner than the main hands.
Mark the minute track and the tachymeter scale at the outer edge in white or black.
Make the pushers and the crown line up with the axis of the case.

fabrics.rule: Use steel for the case, an anodised aluminium insert for the bezel and a domed crystal for the glass. Use perforated leather or a steel bracelet for the strap.

methods: bezel with a printed tachymeter scale
two or three sub dials on the dial
luminous paint on the hands and markers
construction.closures: A buckle or a folding clasp closes the strap; a crown at 3 sets the time; the two pushers start and stop the timer.
construction.details: Two pushers, sub dials with thin hands, a tachymeter scale, a red seconds hand and a perforated strap.

surface.pattern: A matt dial with sub dials in a lighter or darker shade, circular rings in the sub dials and a printed speed scale.
surface.gloss: Brushed steel at 15 to 40 GU; the dial at 2 to 8 GU; the crystal at 85 GU.
surface.wear: The steel scratches and the bezel insert fades; the leather darkens and cracks; the dial can turn from black to brown.

palette.strategy: A steel case and a dark dial with white and cream print, and one signal colour in the hands or the strap stitching.

processes: assembly of a chronograph movement with a cam or a column wheel
printing of the dial in two colours
making.scale: Factory output of a few thousand pieces a year for each reference; each watch passed a timing test.
making.signs: Two pushers, a speed scale, sub dials and a dark dial.

pieces.form: Steel case with two round pushers and a crown
Black bezel with a printed tachymeter scale
Domed crystal over a dial with sub dials
Perforated tan leather strap with a steel buckle
Steel ladder bracelet with a folding clasp

positive: black dial with two sub dials
macro photograph of a pit lane

evidence.title: Steve McQueen Monaco White face CW2118

emotion.target_response: The excitement of speed under control: the viewer sees a precise face that times each lap.

use_cases: a prop for a motor racing film
an image prompt for a chronograph on a driver's wrist
avoid_when: the brief wants a dress watch with a thin case
the brief wants a digital display
the brief wants a function for the sea

modifiers.how: Fuse the case and the bracelet, polish the bevels and add a steel or gold bezel.
Replace the dial with an LED display, remove the pushers' sub dials and use a plain case.
